synth.notes:
21x21 grid of 3x3 blocks parsed from frame colours: walls 10 = H axis row + V axis col (argmax wall-ring counts), pieces ring 5, targets any block with 11, bg 9.
Selection shown by 0 hole centres (wall dots off the intersection first, else piece with 0 centres); A5 cycles H -> V -> pieces (min block) -> H.
A1/A2 move selected H axis or piece up/down, A3/A4 move V axis or piece left/right; pieces blocked by board edge and other pieces; blocked = frame unchanged.
Each piece block mirrors across V, H and both into visible solid 4 blocks (skip on-axis sources, off-board and piece-covered cells); HUD col 63 gains one 12 per effective action.
Unconfirmed: axes pass freely under pieces/targets; piece-on-axis-row hiding mirrors never exercised. Stateless; reused a prior passing program unedited.
